name: Fushimachi Harumi
source:
A painter who loves romance dramas and movies. She is quite popular with men, but due to her shy side and the fact she hates being hit on, she always refuses their offers and advances.
Harumi has always been dissatisfied with the sex she has with her husband, but has never had the courage to tell it.
